# Pradyumna Kumar Sahoo — Applied Data Scientist

> Canonical profile of Pradyumna Kumar Sahoo (Prady029), an Applied Data Scientist based in Hyderabad, India with 5+ years of production AI/ML experience across Healthcare and Enterprise Finance. Specializes in clinical GraphRAG, LLM fine-tuning and serving (MedGemma, Gemma, Unsloth, vLLM), Model Context Protocol (MCP) agents, multimodal voice AI, and computer vision.
